work.text: A fine-tuned checkpoint of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, an open 35 billion parameter model, trained further to act as a coding agent: read a real repository, run shell commands, make edits over several turns. The miner uploads it to HuggingFace or Hippius and commits a v7 reveal on chain. What is paid for is a checkpoint that beats the reigning king in a duel, twice.
work.quote: King-of-the-hill trajectory-distillation subnet on Bittensor (netuid 97, finney).

scoring.text: A duel on sampled coding-task prefixes. Per task an evaluator model rolls three reference runs, reduces them to milestones and writes yes-or-no questions. King and challenger each roll every task twice; judge models answer each question, and a side's score is its mean yes-rate over its runs. A run that collapses into a command loop scores 0 unjudged. The challenger wins when its score beats the king's by 0.025.

split.text: Equal shares across a chain of at most five kings. A new winner takes slot 1 and the sitting kings shift down; the sixth drops off. The weight of 10,000 basis points is split evenly among the members, so the reigning king earns the same as a king it displaced. A member that has been deregistered, or an empty reign, sends its share to burn UID 0.

judges.text: Three validators were active on the 2026-09-09 chain snapshot, of 64 permitted. Commit-reveal is off; weights may change at most once per 100 blocks, and the code refreshes them every 101. The judge is a backend pipeline of services on one Postgres state machine: it ingests commits, validates files, runs the whole duel on remote GPUs with judge models, crowns, and sets weights. Nothing is sampled from miners.
judges.quote: commit_reveal_weights_enabled False, weights_rate_limit 100, max_validators 64; chain-2026-09-09.json active_validators 3

cadence.text: Emission settles every 360 blocks, about 72 minutes. The puzzle turns per duel, not per epoch: a challenger is evaluated when it reaches the front of the queue and must win two separate evals, so a first win only re-queues it at priority 0. A king stands until displaced, then fades out over four further coronations. A new registration is immune from deregistration for 5,000 blocks, about 16 hours.

buyer.text: Nobody is named. The front page offers a Chat with the King link to the current champion and nothing else: no price, no API, no customer and no unit of sale, on the site, in llms.txt or in the repository docs. The miner's income is emission.

exploits.text: Re-rolling the duel: a hotkey is written to a used_hotkeys ledger once its submission finishes eval and cannot submit again, and a first win only re-queues the challenger, so the win must repeat. Copies: a secret-seeded sketch of each tensor rejects earlier entries and noised versions. Looping: 0.61 duplicate commands or a run of 5 scores 0 unjudged. Verdict-shaped text in a candidate's output is stripped before judging.
